```
(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
   hasChanged: activation when current DWORD differs from stored previous scan; combinational, not held.
   hasRisingEdges/risingBits/noOfRisingBits: activation 0->1 bits vs prior scan; computed each scan, not held; no reset input.
   hasFallingEdges/fallingBits/noOfFallingBits: activation 1->0 bits vs prior scan; computed each scan, not held; no reset input.
   Retention/hold: only prevValue is retained; outputs are overwritten every scan from this scan's comparison.
   Explicit reset/deactivation: none defined in PUB001; first scan establishes baseline with no edge/changed outputs.
   Same-scan priority: current value is compared against retained prior word before prior word is updated; one comparison path.
   Units/boundaries: DWORD bits 0..31, USINT counts 0..32, TIME not used, zero-based bit iteration.
*)
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR
    prevValue : DWORD;
    isInitialized : BOOL;
    tmpRising : DWORD;
    tmpFalling : DWORD;
    tmpBitIndex : INT;
END_VAR
IF NOT isInitialized THEN
    hasChanged := FALSE;
    hasRisingEdges := FALSE;
    risingBits := DWORD#0;
    noOfRisingBits := 0;
    hasFallingEdges := FALSE;
    fallingBits := DWORD#0;
    noOfFallingBits := 0;
    prevValue := value;
    isInitialized := TRUE;
    RETURN;
END_IF

hasChanged := value <> prevValue;
tmpRising := value AND (NOT prevValue);
tmpFalling := prevValue AND (NOT value);

risingBits := tmpRising;
fallingBits := tmpFalling;
hasRisingEdges := tmpRising <> DWORD#0;
hasFallingEdges := tmpFalling <> DWORD#0;

noOfRisingBits := 0;
noOfFallingBits := 0;
FOR tmpBitIndex := 0 TO 31 DO
    IF (tmpRising AND SHL(DWORD#1, TO_DINT(tmpBitIndex))) <> DWORD#0 THEN
        noOfRisingBits := TO_USINT(noOfRisingBits + 1);
    END_IF
    IF (tmpFalling AND SHL(DWORD#1, TO_DINT(tmpBitIndex))) <> DWORD#0 THEN
        noOfFallingBits := TO_USINT(noOfFallingBits + 1);
    END_IF
END_FOR

prevValue := value;
```
